svg.title: Samuel Gratarola is a software developer focused on scalable, maintainable web applications. He works across front-end and back-end development, with a particular interest in front-end engineering, reusable UI components, clean architecture, performance and accessibility.

g.text: I build scalable, maintainable web applications
across the front end and back end, with a strong
focus on clean architecture and design patterns.
Front-end engineering is where I'm happiest:
Outside work, I build Claude Code plugins that
bring structure, and a bit of fun, to AI coding.
